subject.title: feat: let plugins control inbound debounce policy

question: Should OpenClaw support per-conversation inbound debounce through a general plugin SDK hook, or through a WhatsApp-owned configuration surface?
rationale: Both this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100970 address the same underlying WhatsApp batching need but create different long-term compatibility contracts. Code review cannot determine which public surface OpenClaw should support permanently.

options.title: Prefer WhatsApp-owned configuration
options.body: Land the narrower per-conversation WhatsApp configuration path and avoid exposing a general hook until another channel proves the shared SDK need.

options.title: Adopt the general plugin hook
options.body: Approve the hook as a deliberate cross-channel SDK contract, then require clear supported-channel scope and live WhatsApp proof before merging.

options.title: Defer both proposals
options.body: Keep current debounce behavior until maintainers define the intended ownership and supported user workflow.

recommendation.title: Prefer WhatsApp-owned configuration
recommendation.body: Land the narrower per-conversation WhatsApp configuration path and avoid exposing a general hook until another channel proves the shared SDK need.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only repository member in the supplied discussion who explicitly took responsibility for reviewing this contract choice.
